title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Good evening
I’m sorry to bug you on a Saturday night but I wanted to ask someone and you’re the only one I feel comfortable doing it with (on a Saturday night)
So, let me send you a few long texts real quick
Okay
So, that story I called you about a long, long time ago. I’ve had a couple breakthroughs. Ron tripped up a little bit and I put some stuff out on Twitter last week, so I’m writing the story soon

And when I’m digging into it, really going through the notes, highlighting on paper - even more than when I heard it on the phone or transcribed it - it became really clear last night that there is a sexism problem within the *ticket* side of things under Dave Baldwin

So I don’t have people going on the record but to give the story more weight and perhaps broaden it, I was going to reach out to every female who’s left since 2018 and see if they’ll answer me an anonymous yes or no question if there is a sexism problem
So, as a female who has left in that timeframe, do you think there’s a sexism problem within the organization?
Off the record, of course
Can I call
Yeah for sure
Oh I meant to ask what happened the night of the draft!? Someone sent me your text about the lovely media relations dept.
We were supposed to have media availability with Pleis, etc., *maybe* Torkelson at like 10:30
Tigers picked him at 7 p.m.
We -- at least me -- I understood they probably wouldn’t be able to get Torkelson, (because they suck)
But then Chad e-mails at like 11 saying the availability is canceled
Like, you gotta pull SOMEONE together, boys. Let’s go.
No. 1 OVERALL pick
You know who it looks worst on?
Baseball ops
I was gonna say Ron
Because you gotta have the kind of authority to get SOMEONE on there and not ever get it to the point of Chad sending that e-mail out
I agree
Like, Al, Scott Pleis, Tram, whoever, someone needs to get on this call
Ideally, you’d have people that have the ability to do that
Meanwhile, Chad Crunk is in Northville or wherever the fuck he is biting his nails
And Ben is trying to get the best angle on his Instagram live story with the Tigers hat in the background
So accurate
Rachel Barnett, Ashley Baughman, Jorden Bagley, Madison Curl, Michelle Fields, Jessica Langolf, Kendall Maxwell
